        @media (max-width: 768px) {

        /*
         * ── Face ID button: iOS-only hard lock ──────────────────────────────
         * By default the button is visibility:hidden + pointer-events:none.
         * JS sets the class 'ios-bio-ready' on <html> ONLY after isIOSDevice()
         * returns true, which requires iPad/iPhone/iPod UA or iPadOS Macintosh
         * + maxTouchPoints > 1.  Android never satisfies either condition, so
         * this rule keeps the button permanently invisible and untappable there,
         * even if something else tries to set display:inline-block on it.
         */
        .ios-biometric-btn {
            visibility: hidden !important;
            pointer-events: none !important;
        }
        html.ios-bio-ready .ios-biometric-btn {
            visibility: visible !important;
            pointer-events: auto !important;
        }
    </style>

    
    <script>
        (function() {
            var ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
            var isIPadOS  = /Macintosh/i.test(ua) && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1;
            var isIOS     = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/i.test(ua) || isIPadOS;
            var isAndroid = /android/i.test(ua);   // explicit Android block
            if (isIOS && !isAndroid) {
                document.documentElement.classList.add('ios-bio-ready-pending');
            }
        })();
    </script>

   <script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    let deferredPrompt;
    const installFab = document.getElementById('installCenterFab');
    const installBtn = document.getElementById('btnInstall');
    const iosHint = document.getElementById('iosHint');
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;
    const isIOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/i.test(ua);
    const isAndroid = /android/i.test(ua);

    function isStandalone() {
        return window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches
            || window.navigator.standalone === true;
    }

    if (installFab) installFab.style.display = "none";

    if (isStandalone()) return;

    if ((isAndroid || isIOS) && installFab)
        installFab.style.display = "block";

    // Register Service Worker
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
        navigator.serviceWorker.register('./service-worker.js')
            .catch(function (err) {
                console.log("SW Error:", err);
            });
    }

    // Capture install prompt (for future use)
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', function (e) {
        deferredPrompt = e;
    });

    // -----------------------------------------------------
    // Inject styles (used only if you later want APK downloads)
    // -----------------------------------------------------
    function injectStyles() {
        if (document.getElementById('_apk_style')) return;

        var s = document.createElement('style');
        s.id = '_apk_style';
        s.textContent =
            '#_apk_bar{' +
            'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;' +
            'background:#1e1e1e;' +
            'padding:10px 14px;' +
            'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;' +
            'z-index:99999;' +
            'font-family:sans-serif;' +
            'box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);' +
            'transform:translateY(-100%);' +
            'transition:transform 0.3s ease}' +

            '#_apk_bar.show{transform:translateY(0)}' +

            '#_apk_bar .bar-prog{' +
            'position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:#333}' +

            '#_apk_bar .bar-prog-fill{' +
            'height:100%;width:0;background:#1a73e8;' +
            'transition:width 3s ease}' +

            '#_apk_bar .bar-icon{' +
            'width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:8px;' +
            'background:#1a73e8;flex-shrink:0;' +
            'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;' +
            'font-size:17px;color:#fff}' +

            '#_apk_bar .bar-texts{flex:1;min-width:0}' +

            '#_apk_bar .bar-name{' +
            'color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;' +
            'white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}' +

            '#_apk_bar .bar-path{' +
            'color:#999;font-size:10px;margin-top:1px;' +
            'white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}' +

            '#_apk_bar .bar-open{' +
            'background:#1a73e8;color:#fff;border:none;' +
            'border-radius:7px;padding:6px 13px;' +
            'font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;' +
            'flex-shrink:0;white-space:nowrap}' +

            '#_apk_bar .bar-close{' +
            'color:#666;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;' +
            'flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;padding:0 2px}';

        document.head.appendChild(s);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------
    // APK Download Functions (kept for future use)
    // -----------------------------------------------------
    function showTopBar(apkUrl, fileName) {
        injectStyles();

        var old = document.getElementById('_apk_bar');
        if (old) old.remove();

        var bar = document.createElement('div');
        bar.id = '_apk_bar';

        bar.innerHTML =
            '<div class="bar-icon">&#8659;</div>' +
            '<div class="bar-texts">' +
            '<div class="bar-name">' + fileName + '</div>' +
            '<div class="bar-path">Downloads / ' + fileName + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button class="bar-open" id="_apk_open_btn">Open</button>' +
            '<span class="bar-close" id="_apk_close_btn">&#10005;</span>' +
            '<div class="bar-prog"><div class="bar-prog-fill" id="_apk_prog_fill"></div></div>';

        document.body.appendChild(bar);

        requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            requestAnimationFrame(function () {
                bar.classList.add('show');
                var fill = document.getElementById('_apk_prog_fill');
                if (fill) fill.style.width = '100%';
            });
        });

        document.getElementById('_apk_open_btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
            window.location.href = apkUrl;
        });

        document.getElementById('_apk_close_btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
            bar.classList.remove('show');
            setTimeout(function () {
                bar.remove();
            }, 300);
        });

        setTimeout(function () {
            var b = document.getElementById('_apk_bar');
            if (b) {
                b.classList.remove('show');
                setTimeout(function () {
                    b.remove();
                }, 300);
            }
        }, 15000);
    }

    function downloadApk(apkUrl, fileName) {
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = apkUrl;
        a.download = fileName;
        a.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();

        setTimeout(function () {
            a.remove();
        }, 300);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------
    // INSTALL BUTTON CLICK
    // -----------------------------------------------------
    if (installBtn) {
        installBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {

            // Android → Open Play Store
            if (isAndroid && !isStandalone()) {

                // Try opening Play Store app
                window.location.href =
                    'market://details?id=com.resourceplus.app';

                // Fallback to web Play Store after 1 second
                setTimeout(function () {
                    window.location.href =
                        'https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.resourceplus.app';
                }, 1000);

                return;
            }

            // iOS
            if (isIOS && iosHint) {
                iosHint.style.display = "block";

                setTimeout(function () {
                    iosHint.style.display = "none";
                }, 5000);

                return;
            }
        });
    }

    // Hide install button after app install
    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', function () {
        if (installFab)
            installFab.style.display = "none";
    });
});
</script>

      <script>
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  BIOMETRIC / WEBAUTHN  (v5)
        //
        //  UX FLOW:
        //  1. Password login success  → hfBioPending set → showBiometricPrompt()
        //       Not enrolled  → "Enable Face ID?" Yes/No popup
        //                         Yes → register → redirect to dashboard
        //                         No  → redirect to dashboard
        //       Enrolled      → "Use Face ID?" Yes/No popup
        //                         Yes → Face ID → redirect to dashboard
        //                         No  → redirect to dashboard
        //  2. App minimized & reopened → checkSession → session alive → redirect
        //                                             → session dead  → Face ID re-auth
        //  3. Cache cleared / logout   → no stored credential → normal login page
        //
        //  Storage: hex credentialId in localStorage (bio_v3_cred_id) + cookie fallback.
        //  Server:  base64url credentialId (converted from hex before each fetch).
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        var BIO_KEY_ID  = 'bio_v3_cred_id';
        var BIO_KEY_USR = 'bio_v3_username';
        var BIO_KEY_ON  = 'bio_v3_enabled';
        var LEGACY_ID_KEYS  = ['bio_cred_id', 'biometric_credential_id'];
        var LEGACY_USR_KEYS = ['bio_username', 'biometric_username'];
        var LEGACY_ON_KEYS  = ['bio_enabled',  'biometric_enabled'];

        // ── isIOSDevice ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // Face ID / biometric runs ONLY on iOS. Returns false for Android.
        // iPad OS 13+ reports as Macintosh — detected via maxTouchPoints.
        function isIOSDevice() {
            var ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
            // Explicit Android exclusion — Android devices can have high maxTouchPoints
            // and some Android UA strings may contain "Macintosh" in edge cases.
            if (/android/i.test(ua)) return false;
            var isIPadOS = /Macintosh/i.test(ua) && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1;
            return /iPad|iPhone|iPod/i.test(ua) || isIPadOS;
        }

        // ── normalizeToHex ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // Accepts any credentialId format (hex / base64url / base64) → hex string
        function normalizeToHex(raw) {
            if (!raw) return null;
            raw = raw.trim();
            // Already pure hex?
            if (/^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(raw) && raw.length >= 16 && raw.length % 2 === 0)
                return raw.toLowerCase();
            // Try base64url / base64 → hex
            try {
                var b64 = raw.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
                var mod = b64.length % 4;
                if (mod === 2) b64 += '==';
                else if (mod === 3) b64 += '=';
                var bin = atob(b64);
                if (bin.length < 8) return null;
                var hex = '';
                for (var i = 0; i < bin.length; i++)
                    hex += ('0' + bin.charCodeAt(i).toString(16)).slice(-2);
                return hex;
            } catch (e) { return null; }
        }

        function hexToBuffer(hex) {
            var arr = new Uint8Array(hex.length / 2);
            for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
                arr[i] = parseInt(hex.substr(i * 2, 2), 16);
            return arr.buffer;
        }
        function bufferToHex(buf) {
            return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf))
                .map(function(b){ return ('0' + b.toString(16)).slice(-2); }).join('');
        }
        function hexToBase64url(hex) {
            var arr = new Uint8Array(hex.length / 2);
            for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) arr[i] = parseInt(hex.substr(i*2,2),16);
            var bin = '';
            for (var j = 0; j < arr.length; j++) bin += String.fromCharCode(arr[j]);
            return btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=/g,'');
        }

        // ── migrateLegacyCredential ───────────────────────────────────────────
        // Converts any old-format stored credential to v3 hex on first load
        function migrateLegacyCredential() {
            try {
                if (localStorage.getItem(BIO_KEY_ON) === 'true' && localStorage.getItem(BIO_KEY_ID)) return;
                var oldId = null, oldUsr = null;
                for (var i = 0; i < LEGACY_ID_KEYS.length; i++) {
                    var v = localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_ID_KEYS[i]);
                    if (v) { oldId = v; break; }
                }
                for (var j = 0; j < LEGACY_USR_KEYS.length; j++) {
                    var u = localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_USR_KEYS[j]);
                    if (u) { oldUsr = u; break; }
                }
                if (!oldId || !oldUsr) return;
                var hexId = normalizeToHex(oldId);
                if (!hexId) { clearBiometricCredential(); return; }
                localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_ID, hexId);
                localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_USR, oldUsr);
                localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_ON, 'true');
                console.log('[Bio] Migrated legacy credential for:', oldUsr);
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        // ── saveBiometricCredential ───────────────────────────────────────────
        function saveBiometricCredential(hexCredId, username) {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_ID,  hexCredId);
                localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_USR, username);
                localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_ON,  'true');
            } catch(e) {}
            try {
                var exp = new Date(); exp.setFullYear(exp.getFullYear() + 1);
                document.cookie = 'bio_v3='
                    + encodeURIComponent(hexCredId) + '!!'
                    + encodeURIComponent(username)
                    + '; expires=' + exp.toUTCString() + '; path=/; SameSite=Lax';
            } catch(e) {}
            console.log('[Bio] Credential saved for:', username);
        }

        // ── clearBiometricCredential ──────────────────────────────────────────
        function clearBiometricCredential() {
            try {
                localStorage.removeItem(BIO_KEY_ID);
                localStorage.removeItem(BIO_KEY_USR);
                localStorage.removeItem(BIO_KEY_ON);
                localStorage.removeItem('bio_last_active_page');
                LEGACY_ID_KEYS.forEach(function(k)  { localStorage.removeItem(k); });
                LEGACY_USR_KEYS.forEach(function(k) { localStorage.removeItem(k); });
                LEGACY_ON_KEYS.forEach(function(k)  { localStorage.removeItem(k); });
            } catch(e) {}
            ['bio_v3','bio_cred'].forEach(function(n){
                document.cookie = n + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC; path=/; SameSite=Lax';
            });
        }

        // ── getStoredCredential ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        function getStoredCredential() {
            migrateLegacyCredential();
            var credId = null, uname = null;
            try {
                credId = localStorage.getItem(BIO_KEY_ID);
                uname  = localStorage.getItem(BIO_KEY_USR);
            } catch(e) {}
            // Cookie fallback
            if (!credId || !uname) {
                try {
                    var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)bio_v3=([^;]+)/);
                    if (m) {
                        var raw = m[1], sep = raw.indexOf('!!');
                        if (sep !== -1) {
                            credId = decodeURIComponent(raw.substring(0, sep));
                            uname  = decodeURIComponent(raw.substring(sep + 2));
                        }
                    }
                    // Legacy cookie fallbacks
                    if (!credId) {
                        var m2 = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)bio_cred=([^;]+)/);
                        if (m2) {
                            var raw2 = m2[1];
                            var sep2 = raw2.indexOf('%E2%80%96');
                            if (sep2 !== -1) {
                                credId = normalizeToHex(decodeURIComponent(raw2.substring(0, sep2)));
                                uname  = decodeURIComponent(raw2.substring(sep2 + 9));
                            } else {
                                var parts = decodeURIComponent(raw2).split('|');
                                credId = normalizeToHex(parts[0]);
                                uname  = parts.slice(1).join('|');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (credId && uname) {
                        try {
                            localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_ID, credId);
                            localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_USR, uname);
                            localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_ON, 'true');
                        } catch(e) {}
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }
            // Validate — must be proper hex
            if (credId) {
                var norm = normalizeToHex(credId);
                if (!norm) { clearBiometricCredential(); return { credentialId:null, username:null, enrolled:false }; }
                if (norm !== credId) { credId = norm; try { localStorage.setItem(BIO_KEY_ID, credId); } catch(e){} }
            }
            return { credentialId: credId, username: uname, enrolled: !!(credId && uname) };
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  PAGE ENTRY LOGIC
        //
        //  iOS Safari uses BFCache (Back-Forward Cache) — when the user minimizes
        //  and reopens the app, the page is THAWED not reloaded.
        //  DOMContentLoaded does NOT fire on BFCache restore.
        //
        //  We handle ALL entry points:
        //    • DOMContentLoaded  — normal first load / hard reload
        //    • pageshow (persisted=true) — BFCache restore (iOS minimize→reopen)
        //    • visibilitychange (visible) — tab/app comes back to foreground
        //
        //  Entry priority:
        //  1. hfBioPending set → fresh password login → show biometric prompt
        //  2. Stored credential exists → ALWAYS require Face ID first:
        //       Face ID passes + session alive → redirect to app (session reused)
        //       Face ID passes + session dead  → biometricLogin → new session → app
        //  3. No credential    → normal login page
        //
        //  IMPORTANT: session alive NEVER bypasses Face ID.
        //  Face ID is always required when app is reopened / minimized.
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        // Guard: prevent running the check more than once per page activation
        var _bioCheckDone = false;

        function getReturnUrl() {
            var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            var ru = urlParams.get('ReturnUrl') || urlParams.get('returnurl') || urlParams.get('ru');
            if (ru && ru.trim() !== '') {
                return decodeURIComponent(ru.trim());
            }
            try {
                var storedUrl = localStorage.getItem('bio_last_active_page');
                if (storedUrl && storedUrl.trim() !== '') {
                    return storedUrl;
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            return null;
        }

        function performRedirect(targetUrl) {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('bio_last_active_page', targetUrl);
            } catch(e) {}
            window.location.href = targetUrl;
        }

        function runBioEntryCheck() {
            // iOS ONLY — skip all biometric logic on Android
            if (!isIOSDevice()) {
                console.log('[Bio] Not iOS — biometric skipped');
                return;
            }

            // ── CASE 1: fresh password login ──────────────────────────────────
            var hf  = document.getElementById('hfBioPending');
            var val = hf ? hf.value : '';
            console.log('[Bio] runBioEntryCheck | hfBioPending:', val || '(empty)');

            if (val && val.indexOf('|') !== -1) {
                var parts = val.split('|');
                if (parts.length >= 3) {
                    var userId      = parts[0];
                    var username    = parts[1];
                    var redirectUrl = parts.slice(2).join('|');
                    if (hf) hf.value = ''; // prevent re-fire on back button
                    _bioCheckDone = true;
                    showBiometricPrompt(userId, username, redirectUrl);
                    return;
                }
            }

            // ── LOGOUT DETECTION ──────────────────────────────────────────────
            // If the URL contains ?Logout or ?lo=1, the user explicitly signed out.
            // Clear ALL biometric data so the next login starts fresh (enroll again).
            var qs = window.location.search.toLowerCase();
            if (qs.indexOf('logout') !== -1 || qs.indexOf('lo=1') !== -1) {
                console.log('[Bio] Logout detected — clearing biometric data');
                clearBiometricCredential();
                _bioCheckDone = true;
                updateBioUIState();
                return; // show normal login page
            }

            // ── CASE 2: credential on device → check session → Face ID ───────
            var stored = getStoredCredential();
            if (!stored.enrolled || !stored.credentialId) {
                console.log('[Bio] No stored credential — normal login page');
                _bioCheckDone = true;
                updateBioUIState();
                return;
            }

            console.log('[Bio] Credential found for:', stored.username, '— requiring Face ID...');
            _bioCheckDone = true;
            updateBioUIState();

            // ── ALWAYS require Face ID when app is reopened ───────────────────
            // We do NOT check session first and bypass Face ID.
            // Face ID is always required — session state only affects what
            // happens AFTER Face ID succeeds:
            //   • Session alive → just redirect (session already valid)
            //   • Session dead  → biometricLogin creates a new session first
            //
            // Show overlay immediately (important for BFCache restore on iOS
            // where the page appears instantly without any load indicator)
            showReAuthOverlay(true, 'Face ID required to continue…');

            // Small delay so the overlay renders before the Face ID sheet appears
            setTimeout(function() {
                triggerBiometricReAuth(stored.credentialId);
            }, 120);
        }

        function ensureWindowFocused(callback) {
            if (document.hasFocus()) {
                console.log('[Bio] Window is focused, proceeding');
                callback();
            } else {
                console.log('[Bio] Window is NOT focused. Waiting for focus...');
                var resolved = false;
                var onFocus = function() {
                    if (!resolved) {
                        resolved = true;
                        window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus);
                        console.log('[Bio] Window focused via event, running callback after brief delay');
                        setTimeout(callback, 200);
                    }
                };
                window.addEventListener('focus', onFocus);
                // Fallback timeout of 1.2s
                setTimeout(function() {
                    if (!resolved) {
                        resolved = true;
                        window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus);
                        console.log('[Bio] Focus fallback timeout reached, proceeding');
                        callback();
                    }
                }, 1200);
            }
        }

        function triggerManualBioReAuth() {
            // Hard guard — Face ID is iOS only; do nothing on Android
            if (!isIOSDevice()) return;
            var stored = getStoredCredential();
            if (stored.enrolled && stored.credentialId) {
                triggerBiometricReAuth(stored.credentialId);
            } else {
                showSimpleSweetAlert('Not Registered', 'Please log in with password and enable biometric authentication first.', 'info');
            }
        }

        function updateBioUIState() {
            try {
                var btn = document.getElementById('btnShowBio');

                // ── ANDROID (and all non-iOS): absolute hard block ────────────
                // Three independent checks — any one failing hides the button:
                //  1. isIOSDevice() must return true (UA-based, Android-blocked)
                //  2. The inline <head> script must have set ios-bio-ready-pending
                //     (it only does so when isIOS && !isAndroid at parse time)
                //  3. Neither check uses a timer or session state
                var pendingSet = document.documentElement.classList.contains('ios-bio-ready-pending');
                if (!isIOSDevice() || !pendingSet) {
                    document.documentElement.classList.remove('ios-bio-ready');
                    document.documentElement.classList.remove('ios-bio-ready-pending');
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.style.display    = 'none';
                        btn.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // ── iOS only beyond this point ────────────────────────────────
                var stored = getStoredCredential();
                if (stored.enrolled && stored.credentialId) {
                    document.documentElement.classList.add('ios-bio-ready');
                    if (btn) btn.style.display = 'inline-block';
                } else {
                    document.documentElement.classList.remove('ios-bio-ready');
                    if (btn) btn.style.display = 'none';
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        // ── Entry point 1: normal page load ───────────────────────────────────
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            console.log('[Bio] DOMContentLoaded');
            _bioCheckDone = false;
            runBioEntryCheck();
            updateBioUIState();
        });

        // ── Entry point 2: BFCache restore (iOS minimize → reopen) ───────────
        // iOS Safari freezes the page into BFCache when the app is minimized.
        // On reopen it thaws the page — pageshow fires with e.persisted = true.
        // DOMContentLoaded does NOT fire in this case.
        window.addEventListener('pageshow', function(e) {
            console.log('[Bio] pageshow | persisted:', e.persisted);
            if (e.persisted && isIOSDevice()) {
                // iOS BFCache restore — reset guard and trigger Face ID check
                _bioCheckDone = false;
                runBioEntryCheck();
                updateBioUIState();
            }
        });

        // ── Entry point 3: visibilitychange (app comes to foreground) ─────────
        // Covers cases where pageshow may not fire (some Android WebViews, PWA).
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
            if (!isIOSDevice()) return; // Android: do nothing
            console.log('[Bio] visibilitychange | state:', document.visibilityState);
            if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                _bioCheckDone = false;
                runBioEntryCheck();
                updateBioUIState();
            }
            if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
                _bioCheckDone = false;
            }
        });

        // ── Entry point 4: Cordova/Capacitor resume event ──────────────────────
        document.addEventListener('resume', function() {
            if (!isIOSDevice()) return; // Android: do nothing
            console.log('[Bio] resume event received');
            _bioCheckDone = false;
            runBioEntryCheck();
            updateBioUIState();
        }, false);

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  triggerBiometricReAuth
        //
        //  ALWAYS called when app is reopened/minimized and credential exists.
        //  Step 1: Face ID / Touch ID via credentials.get()
        //  Step 2 (after Face ID passes):
        //    • Check server session status
        //    • Session alive → redirect directly (no need to re-login)
        //    • Session dead  → call biometricLogin to create new session → redirect
        //
        //  Face ID MUST pass before any app access — session state never bypasses it.
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        function triggerBiometricReAuth(hexCredId) {
            console.log('[Bio] triggerBiometricReAuth()');

            if (!window.PublicKeyCredential) {
                showReAuthOverlay(false);
                return;
            }

            var hexId = normalizeToHex(hexCredId);
            if (!hexId) {
                showReAuthOverlay(false);
                clearBiometricCredential();
                showSimpleSweetAlert('Re-enroll Required',
                    'Stored credential is invalid. Please login with your password.', 'warning');
                return;
            }

            var credBuffer;
            try { credBuffer = hexToBuffer(hexId); }
            catch(e) {
                showReAuthOverlay(false);
                showSimpleSweetAlert('Error', 'Could not prepare credential: ' + e.message, 'error');
                return;
            }

            var challenge = new Uint8Array(32);
            window.crypto.getRandomValues(challenge);

            showReAuthOverlay(true, 'Verifying Face ID…');

            ensureWindowFocused(function() {
                console.log('[Bio] Triggering credentials.get...');
                navigator.credentials.get({
                    publicKey: {
                        challenge:        challenge,
                        // rpId MUST be set explicitly and match the rpId used at
                        // registration time. Without it, iOS infers the RP ID from
                        // the current hostname — but after BFCache restore or when
                        // the page is thawed 30-60+ minutes later, Safari's
                        // internal credential store lookup fails with
                        // "The string did not match the expected pattern".
                        rpId:             window.location.hostname,
                        timeout:          120000,
                        userVerification: 'preferred',
                        allowCredentials: [{ type: 'public-key', id: credBuffer }]
                    }
                })
                .then(function(assertion) {
                    // Face ID passed — call biometricLogin directly.
                    // No checkSession (causes HTML redirect on expired session).
                    // No credentials cookie (expired cookie triggers redirect).
                    // If BiometricApi.aspx is blocked (URL Auth), auto-fallback
                    // to Default.aspx?bioauth=1 which is always accessible.
                    console.log('[Bio] Face ID passed — logging in');
                    showReAuthOverlay(true, 'Logging in…');

                    var serverCredId = hexToBase64url(hexId);

                    function tryLogin(credId) {
                        return fetch('BiometricApi.aspx', {
                            method:  'POST',
                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                            body:    JSON.stringify({ action: 'biometricLogin', credentialId: credId })
                        })
                        .then(function(r) {
                            var ct = r.headers.get('content-type') || '';
                            if (ct.indexOf('application/json') === -1) {
                                // BiometricApi.aspx blocked — use login-page fallback
                                console.warn('[Bio] BiometricApi blocked, using Default.aspx?bioauth=1');
                                return fetch('Default.aspx?bioauth=1', {
                                    method:  'POST',
                                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                                    body:    JSON.stringify({ credentialId: credId })
                                }).then(function(r2) { return r2.json(); });
                            }
                            return r.json();
                        });
                    }

                    return tryLogin(serverCredId)
                    .then(function(resp) {
                        showReAuthOverlay(false);
                        if (resp.status === 'success') {
                            console.log('[Bio] Login OK — redirecting');
                            performRedirect(getReturnUrl() || resp.redirect || 'NSPAPP_ESSDashboard.aspx');
                        } else {
                            // Only clear stored credential if it is genuinely not in the DB.
                            // Do NOT clear on server/network errors — credential may still be valid.
                            if (resp.message && resp.message.indexOf('not found') !== -1)
                                clearBiometricCredential();
                            showSimpleSweetAlert('Authentication Failed',
                                resp.message || 'Please login with your password.', 'error');
                        }
                    });
                })
                .catch(function(err) {
                    showReAuthOverlay(false);
                    console.log('[Bio] Face ID error:', err.name, err.message);
                    if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
                        // User cancelled — show login form, do not clear credential
                        showSimpleSweetAlert('Face ID Cancelled',
                            'Authentication cancelled. Please login with your password.', 'warning');
                    } else if (err.name === 'NotFoundError' || err.name === 'InvalidStateError') {
                        clearBiometricCredential();
                        showSimpleSweetAlert('Re-enroll Required',
                            'Face ID was removed from this device. Please login with your password to re-enable.', 'warning');
                    } else if (err.name === 'SecurityError') {
                        showSimpleSweetAlert('HTTPS Required',
                            'Biometric login requires a secure HTTPS connection.', 'error');
                    } else {
                        showSimpleSweetAlert('Face ID Error',
                            err.message || 'Authentication failed. Please login with your password.', 'warning');
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        // ── showReAuthOverlay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // Shows/hides a simple "Authenticating with Face ID…" overlay so
        // the user isn't staring at a blank login form waiting for Face ID.
        // show=true/false, msg=optional message to display
        function showReAuthOverlay(show, msg) {
            var el = document.getElementById('bioReAuthOverlay');
            if (!el) {
                el = document.createElement('div');
                el.id = 'bioReAuthOverlay';
                el.style.cssText = [
                    'position:fixed','top:0','left:0','width:100%','height:100%',
                    'background:rgba(255,255,255,0.96)','z-index:99999',
                    'display:flex','flex-direction:column',
                    'align-items:center','justify-content:center','gap:18px',
                    '-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px)','backdrop-filter:blur(4px)'
                ].join(';');
                el.innerHTML =
                    '<div id="bioOverlayIcon" style="font-size:58px">&#x1F510;</div>' +
                    '<div id="bioOverlayMsg" style="font-size:17px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2e5a;text-align:center;padding:0 24px"></div>' +
                    '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#6c757d">Please look at your device</div>';
                document.body.appendChild(el);
            }
            if (show) {
                var msgEl = document.getElementById('bioOverlayMsg');
                if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = msg || 'Authenticating with Face ID…';
                el.style.display = 'flex';
            } else {
                el.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  showBiometricPrompt
        //  Called after every successful password login.
        //  • Already enrolled  → skip Yes/No, go straight to Face ID.
        //  • Not enrolled      → ask Yes/No first.
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        function showBiometricPrompt(userId, username, redirectUrl) {
            console.log('[Bio] showBiometricPrompt() for:', username);

            // iOS ONLY — on Android redirect directly without biometric prompt
            if (!isIOSDevice()) {
                console.log('[Bio] Not iOS — skipping biometric prompt');
                performRedirect(redirectUrl);
                return;
            }

                        if (!window.PublicKeyCredential) {
                console.log('[Bio] WebAuthn not supported — redirecting');
                performRedirect(redirectUrl);
                return;
            }

            var stored = getStoredCredential();

            if (stored.enrolled && stored.credentialId) {
                // ── Already enrolled: show popup then trigger Face ID on Yes ──
                // The popup appears on EVERY login after the user has enrolled.
                // Tapping Yes fires Face ID immediately — no password re-entry.
                swal({
                    title:              'Biometric Login',
                    text:               'Sign in with Face ID or fingerprint?',
                    type:               'info',
                    showCancelButton:   true,
                    confirmButtonText:  'Yes, Use Face ID',
                    cancelButtonText:   'No, Skip',
                    confirmButtonColor: '#0d6efd'
                }, function (confirmed) {
                    if (confirmed) {
                        triggerBiometricLogin(stored.credentialId, redirectUrl);
                    } else {
                        performRedirect(redirectUrl);
                    }
                });
            } else {
                // ── Not yet enrolled: offer to enable ────────────────────────
                swal({
                    title:              'Enable Face ID / Biometric?',
                    text:               'Sign in instantly next time using Face ID or fingerprint.',
                    type:               'info',
                    showCancelButton:   true,
                    confirmButtonText:  'Yes, Enable',
                    cancelButtonText:   'No, Skip',
                    confirmButtonColor: '#0d6efd'
                }, function (confirmed) {
                    if (confirmed) {
                        registerBiometric(userId, username, redirectUrl);
                    } else {
                        performRedirect(redirectUrl);
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  triggerBiometricLogin
        //  Calls credentials.get() (Face ID / Touch ID) then POSTs to server
        //  redirectUrl is passed through so we can redirect after success
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        function triggerBiometricLogin(hexCredId, redirectUrl) {
            console.log('[Bio] triggerBiometricLogin()');

            var hexId = normalizeToHex(hexCredId);
            if (!hexId) {
                clearBiometricCredential();
                showSimpleSweetAlert('Re-enroll Required',
                    'Stored credential is invalid. Please login with your password to re-enable Face ID.', 'warning');
                setTimeout(function(){ performRedirect(redirectUrl || 'Default.aspx'); }, 2500);
                return;
            }

            var credBuffer;
            try { credBuffer = hexToBuffer(hexId); }
            catch(e) {
                showSimpleSweetAlert('Error', 'Could not prepare credential: ' + e.message, 'error');
                return;
            }

            var challenge = new Uint8Array(32);
            window.crypto.getRandomValues(challenge);

            console.log('[Bio] Calling credentials.get()...');

            navigator.credentials.get({
                publicKey: {
                    challenge:        challenge,
                    // rpId must match registration. Explicit value prevents
                    // "The string did not match the expected pattern" errors.
                    rpId:             window.location.hostname,
                    timeout:          120000,
                    userVerification: 'preferred',
                    allowCredentials: [{ type: 'public-key', id: credBuffer }]
                }
            })
            .then(function (assertion) {
                console.log('[Bio] Face ID / Touch ID success');
                var serverCredId = hexToBase64url(hexId);
                return sendBiometricLoginToServer(serverCredId, redirectUrl);
            })
            .catch(function (err) {
                console.log('[Bio] credentials.get() error:', err.name, err.message);
                if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
                    // User cancelled or timed out — let them try password again
                    showSimpleSweetAlert('Authentication Cancelled',
                        'Face ID was cancelled. You can login with your password.', 'warning');
                } else if (err.name === 'NotFoundError' || err.name === 'InvalidStateError') {
                    clearBiometricCredential();
                    showSimpleSweetAlert('Re-enroll Required',
                        'Face ID was removed from this device. Please login with password to re-enable.', 'warning');
                } else if (err.name === 'SecurityError') {
                    showSimpleSweetAlert('HTTPS Required',
                        'Biometric login requires a secure HTTPS connection.', 'error');
                } else {
                    showSimpleSweetAlert('Biometric Error',
                        err.message || 'Authentication failed.', 'warning');
                }
            });
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  sendBiometricLoginToServer
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        function sendBiometricLoginToServer(base64urlCredId, redirectUrl) {
            console.log('[Bio] Sending to server...');
            return fetch('BiometricApi.aspx', {
                method:      'POST',
                headers:     { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body:        JSON.stringify({ action: 'biometricLogin', credentialId: base64urlCredId })
            })
            .then(function(r) {
                if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
                var ct = r.headers.get('content-type') || '';
                if (ct.indexOf('application/json') === -1) {
                    // Auto-fallback to Default.aspx?bioauth=1
                    console.warn('[Bio] BiometricApi blocked in sendBiometricLoginToServer');
                    return fetch('Default.aspx?bioauth=1', {
                        method:  'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body:    JSON.stringify({ credentialId: base64urlCredId })
                    }).then(function(rf) { return rf.json(); });
                }
                return r.json();
            })
            .then(function(resp) {
                console.log('[Bio] Server:', resp.status);
                if (resp.status === 'success') {
                    var target = getReturnUrl() || resp.redirect || redirectUrl;
                    performRedirect(target);
                } else {
                    if (resp.message && (resp.message.indexOf('Invalid') !== -1 ||
                                         resp.message.indexOf('expired') !== -1)) {
                        clearBiometricCredential();
                    }
                    showSimpleSweetAlert('Login Failed', resp.message || 'Authentication failed.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                showSimpleSweetAlert('Network Error', err.message || 'Could not reach server.', 'error');
            });
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  registerBiometric
        //  Called when user taps "Yes, Enable" on the enrollment popup
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        function registerBiometric(userId, username, redirectUrl) {
            console.log('[Bio] registerBiometric() for:', username);

            var challenge = new Uint8Array(32);
            window.crypto.getRandomValues(challenge);
            var hexCredId = null;

            navigator.credentials.create({
                publicKey: {
                    challenge: challenge,
                    // rp.id MUST be set here to match what credentials.get()
                    // uses later. Omitting it causes iOS to default to the
                    // effective domain, which can differ from window.location.hostname
                    // after app restore, causing permanent "pattern mismatch" errors.
                    rp:        { name: 'NSP Application', id: window.location.hostname },
                    user: {
                        id:          new TextEncoder().encode(userId),
                        name:        username,
                        displayName: username
                    },
                    pubKeyCredParams: [
                        { alg: -7,   type: 'public-key' },
                        { alg: -257, type: 'public-key' }
                    ],
                    authenticatorSelection: {
                        authenticatorAttachment: 'platform',
                        userVerification:        'preferred',
                        requireResidentKey:       false
                    },
                    attestation: 'none'
                }
            })
            .then(function(credential) {
                hexCredId            = bufferToHex(credential.rawId);
                var serverCredId     = hexToBase64url(hexCredId);
                console.log('[Bio] Credential created — registering with server...');
                return fetch('BiometricApi.aspx', {
                    method:  'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body:    JSON.stringify({
                        action:       'register',
                        credentialId:  serverCredId,
                        username:      username,
                        userId:        userId
                    })
                });
            })
            .then(function(r) {
                if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
                var ct = r.headers.get("content-type") || "";
                if (ct.indexOf("application/json") === -1) {
                    return { status: 'error', message: 'Registration session error — please refresh and try again.' };
                }
                return r.json();
            })
            .then(function(resp) {
                if (resp.status === 'success') {
                    saveBiometricCredential(hexCredId, username);
                    swal({
                        title: 'Face ID Enabled!',
                        text:  'Your biometric login is set up. Redirecting...',
                        type:  'success', timer: 2000, showConfirmButton: false
                    });
                    setTimeout(function(){ performRedirect(redirectUrl); }, 2100);
                } else {
                    showSimpleSweetAlert('Registration Failed',
                        resp.message || 'Could not register biometric.', 'warning');
                    setTimeout(function(){ performRedirect(redirectUrl); }, 2500);
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                console.log('[Bio] Registration error:', err.name, err.message);
                var msg = 'Could not register biometric.';
                if      (err.name === 'NotAllowedError')   msg = 'Face ID registration was cancelled.';
                else if (err.name === 'NotSupportedError') msg = 'This device does not support biometric login.';
                else if (err.name === 'SecurityError')     msg = 'Biometric requires HTTPS.';
                else if (err.name === 'InvalidStateError') msg = 'A credential already exists. Tap "Remove biometric" and try again.';
                showSimpleSweetAlert('Registration Failed', msg, 'warning');
                setTimeout(function(){ performRedirect(redirectUrl); }, 2500);
            });
        }

        window.showBiometricPrompt     = showBiometricPrompt;
        window.getStoredCredential     = getStoredCredential;
        window.clearBiometricCredential= clearBiometricCredential;
    </script>

</body>

</html>
